title: Build the remaining Mez Systems channel systems
objective: Extend the approved canonical engine into the named non-web channel systems with bounded contracts, golden examples, anti-examples and human gates before whole-system certification.

included: product UI and data visualisation where required
OG, icon, print and environmental outputs
channel-specific accessibility, static and production boundaries
excluded: changing canonical foundations or product identity without a new decision

acceptance: each named channel has a bounded contract, golden examples, anti-examples, verifier and human decision
channel rules inherit canonical foundations and identity without copied or conflicting values
production, accessibility and static-equivalence boundaries are explicit

verification.passCondition: every named channel has the required contract, evidence, verifier and status
Olli approves each bounded channel family before certification

humanGate.approvalQuestion: Do the bounded channel systems extend the Mez design ethos without fragmenting the canonical engine?

stopConditions: a channel invents conflicting foundation or identity values
consumer repository work or deployment is required
a channel is labelled complete without visual and mechanical proof
notes: This is a programme-level task. Individual channel tasks must be bounded before implementation.
FIG-01 closed through H-FIG-02-FIGMA-COMPANION-APPROVAL on 28 July 2026; this channel programme was then priority-deferred by Olli.
SEQ-PRODUCT-UI-FIRST-001 records Olli's 28 July 2026 direction to defer the named non-product channels as low priority. They remain future work and retain their human gates.
Product UI and data visualisation moved into the bounded TASK-UI-01-PRODUCT-UI-DATA-VISUALISATION task and no longer waits on the deferred channel programme.
